name_en: Noppe — a thick, simmered taro dish with scallop, salmon and vegetables
summary_ja: 里芋を主役に、ホタテやサケ、こんにゃくなどを薄味でとろりと煮た新潟の家庭料理で、汁というより煮物に近い。雪深い土地で振る舞い料理として重宝され、冷やしても食べられると伝わる。
summary_en: A Niigata home dish built around taro, gently simmered with scallops, salmon and konjac until thick, closer to a stew than a soup. In this snow-heavy region it became a go-to for gatherings, and some households are said to eat it chilled.
source_title: のっぺ 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kurumafu no nimono — simmered wheel-shaped wheat gluten fu
summary_ja: 小麦グルテンを鉄棒に巻いて焼き上げる新潟の車麩を、白なすやいんげんと一緒に煮た料理。北前船で製法が伝わったとされ、精進料理や行事の煮しめに欠かせない食材として親しまれている。
summary_en: A dish simmering Niigata's wheel-shaped wheat-gluten fu with white eggplant and green beans. Its craft is said to have arrived via kitamae-bune trading ships, and the fu remains a staple of shojin cooking and festive simmered dishes.
source_title: 車麩の煮物 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kujira jiru — salted whale blubber simmered in miso with summer vegetables
summary_ja: 塩漬けの鯨の脂身を、丸なすやゆうがおなどの夏野菜と一緒に味噌で煮る新潟の郷土料理。北前船で運ばれた塩鯨を使う知恵から生まれ、暑い盛りのスタミナ食として食べられてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: A Niigata dish of salted whale blubber simmered in miso with summer vegetables like round eggplant and bottle gourd. Born from the salted whale carried by kitamae-bune ships, it is said to have served as a stamina food through the hottest stretch of summer.
source_title: くじら汁 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Hiyashijiru — a chilled miso soup with cucumber and shiso
summary_ja: だし汁を味噌でのばし、きゅうりや青じそを刻んで加える中越地方の冷たい汁物。夏に食欲が落ちても食べやすいよう工夫された料理で、そのままでもごはんや麺にかけても食べられると伝わる。
summary_en: A chilled soup from the Chuetsu region, dashi thinned with miso and studded with chopped cucumber and shiso. Devised to stay appetizing through the summer heat, it is said to be eaten on its own or poured over rice or noodles.
source_title: 冷やし汁みそ仕立て 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Takenoko jiru — a miso soup of early-summer bamboo shoots and canned mackerel
summary_ja: 初夏だけとれる姫たけのことサバ缶を具にした上越地方の味噌汁。旬が短く貴重な山菜を贅沢に使った一杯とされ、地域によっては身欠きニシンを入れる家庭もあったと伝わる。
summary_en: A Joetsu-region miso soup made with hime-takenoko bamboo shoots, available only in early summer, and canned mackerel. Said to make lavish use of a fleeting mountain vegetable, some households reportedly used dried herring instead.
source_title: 竹の子汁 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
